description: Call this FIRST, before search_tools, when the user's request is one of these jobs of many calls. It answers the few commands to run now: a runner script that makes the calls and hands you results to show the user within seconds. A request that needs several of these jobs is ONE call with `names` (they then run at the same time). `account-analysis`: Use when the user asks to analyze, break down, audit or learn from one or more accounts or creators, or what works for them. `ad-video`: Use when the user asks to create, make or generate a video, an ad, a clip or an image for their app or brand. `ai-visibility`: Use when the user asks about AI visibility, AEO or GEO, whether ChatGPT or Perplexity recommends their brand or app, their share of AI answers against competitors, or which sites AI answers cite in their category. `app-creators`: Use when the user asks who promotes, posts about, reviews or makes UGC for an app or brand, or for a competitor's creator list. `app-profile`: Use when the user asks for a profile, an overview, a snapshot or the key facts of one mobile app, or to look up one app before researching its creators, UGC or ads. `brand-monitor`: Use when the user asks what people say or think about a brand, product or app this week, for brand mentions, social listening, buzz, sentiment or share of voice, or to monitor a competitor's brand. `brand-research`: Use when the user asks to investigate, research in depth, do a teardown or a dossier of a brand, an app, a website or the account promoting it. `category-research`: Use when the user asks to research a category or market, find competitors' ads and content for a product type, or for a category brief before a launch. `company-research`: Use when the user asks to research, profile or look into ONE company, for a company profile or overview, for its pricing, customers, team, hiring and integrations together, or for a company's official social handles; not for finding all its competitors or their ads and SEO (competitor-ads, competitor-seo), and not for a brand's creators and videos (brand-research). `compare-app-ads`: Use when the user asks to compare the ads of several apps or competitors, what X, Y and Z are running, or for a creative teardown of an app category. `competitor-ads`: Use when the user asks for all the ads of a competitor or brand, where a brand advertises, a competitor's paid ads picture, or which new ads a rival started. `competitor-content`: Use when the user asks what content works for a competitor or brand, a competitor's top or best performing videos, their hooks or sounds, or how often a rival posts. `competitor-seo`: Use when the user asks for a competitor's SEO, which keywords or pages bring a rival its traffic, a keyword or backlink gap, or how their site compares in search. `niche-creators`: Use when the user asks for creators, influencers, UGC creators or YouTubers in a niche or topic (skincare, fitness, study tips, budget travel), within a follower range, to hire, contact or partner with; for creators who already posted about one app, use app-creators. `profile-overview`: Use when the user asks for an overview, a profile report or a rundown of ONE account or creator (who is it, how big, what it posted lately, who it follows or who follows it); for a single fact (a follower count, the last videos) one tool call is enough, for what works and why use account-analysis, for the brand behind an account brand-research. `ugc-accounts`: Use when the user asks for all the UGC accounts, creator accounts or pages of a brand or of the account they give. Not for which accounts make a look or style (animated, AI-generated, puppet...): that is viral.search with that style and view: accounts. `ugc-research`: Use when the user asks what UGC hooks, hook ideas or video formats work for an app, a brand or a niche, or for UGC strategy research, also for non-UGC looks (animated, AI-generated, clay, stop-motion, puppet, cartoon, 3D, whiteboard, faceless). `ugc-watch`: Use when the user wants UGC or content research that keeps going (nonstop, ongoing, over time, keep researching, keep watching, monitor or track a niche, an app or accounts), or asks what is new from such research.
